summary: Iter32 — Static code audit of all 14 Stripe checklist items + TypeScript build verification. No live Stripe charges made. All items verified by reading source files.

minor.issue: No idempotency guard: does not return 400 if feeRefundedAt is already set (unlike deposit refund which checks status=REFUNDED). Calling twice could create duplicate Stripe refunds. Spec does not explicitly require idempotency here, but it is a risk.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add idempotency guard to concierge-fee refund — check if feeRefundedAt is already set and return 400 to prevent duplicate Stripe refunds on double-call.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 bug fixes verified correct in source code.
Concierge refund lacks idempotency check (feeRefundedAt not checked before proceeding), unlike deposit refund which has a status=REFUNDED guard. Low risk but worth adding.
Deposit page: stripePromise is initialized at module scope with a placeholder guard — correctly skips loadStripe if pk is missing or placeholder.

create-intent: if existingDeposit.status === 'PENDING' (not PAID), it proceeds to create a new PI but does NOT reuse the existing PENDING deposit record — this could create duplicate PENDING deposits if the buyer retries. Minor edge case but could be improved.
Webhook deposit handler: if deposit.findFirst returns null (PI not linked), launchAuction/emails are silently skipped — acceptable defensive coding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 Stripe checklist items verified PASS via static code analysis. TypeScript build passes (0 errors). Live Stripe keys confirmed in .env.local. No live charges made. One minor: concierge-fee refund missing idempotency guard. create-intent may create duplicate PENDING deposits on retry (existing PENDING deposit not reused).
rca_of_issue: All 4 originally reported bugs (launchAuction not called, missing payment_intent_data.metadata on both send-link endpoints, webhook concierge_fee using stripeFeePIId before it was set) are confirmed fixed in source code.
